title: Senior CRA
description:
**Work Schedule**


Other**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**


At PPD, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life \- enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life\-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100\+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.


This is a great opportunity for experienced Senior CRA's currently working within the life science sector for pharmaceutical companies, biotech companies or CRO's to work with a world\-leading CRO across multiple sponsors, various protocols and therapy areas.


These roles can be performed remotely for CRA's based close to our clinical 'hubs': **Milan, Bologna, Florence, Rome** and **Naples.** Travel requirement will be national across Italy.

**Essential Functions:**
------------------------

* Monitors investigator sites with a risk\-based monitoring approach: applies root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem\-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks.
* Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on\-site and remote monitoring activities.
* Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review.
* Documents observations in reports and letters according to timelines using approved business writing standards.
* Escalates observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follows all issues through to resolution. May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner.
* Participates in the investigator payment process. Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings resolution. Investigates and follows\-up on findings as applicable.
* Participates in investigator meetings as necessary. Identifies potential investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites.
* Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Performs trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.
* Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH\-GCP and applicable regulations. Conducts on\-site file reviews as per project specifications.
* Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM) as required. Ensures study systems are updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System).
* Contributes to the project team by assisting in preparation of project publications/tools and sharing ideas/suggestions with team members.
* Contributes to other project work and initiatives for process improvement, as required.

**Education and Experience:**
-----------------------------

* University degree in a science related field
* CRA Qualified as per the Ministerial Decree dated 15/11/2011 and **at least 3 years** of independent monitoring experience in clinical development phases II\-IV
* Understanding of ICH\-GCP, EU and FDA requirements
* Fluency in English and in Italian
* Valid Driver's License

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**
------------------------------------

* Proven clinical monitoring skills
* Demonstrated understanding of medical/therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology
* Demonstrated ability to attain and maintain a working knowledge of ICH GCPs, applicable regulations and procedural documents
* Well\-developed critical thinking skills, including but not limited to: critical mindset, in\-depth investigation for appropriate root cause analysis and problem solving
* Ability to manage Risk Based Monitoring concepts and processes
* Good oral and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with medical personnel
* Ability to maintain customer focus through the utilization of good listening skills, attention to detail and the ability to perceive customers’ underlying issues
* Good organizational and time management skills
* Effective interpersonal skills
* Attention to detail
* Ability to remain flexible and adaptable in a wide range of scenarios
* Ability to work in a team or independently as require
* Good computer skills: solid knowledge of Microsoft Office and the ability to learn appropriate software


As well as being rewarded a competitive salary, we have an extensive benefits package based around the health and well\-being of our employees. We have a flexible working culture, where PPD truly value a work\-life balance. We’ve grown sustainably year on year but continue to offer a collaborative environment, with teams of colleagues eager to share expertise and have fun together. We are a global organization but with a local feel.

**Our 4i Values:**

**Integrity – Innovation – Intensity – Involvement**


If you resonate with our 4i values above, and ultimately wish to accelerate the delivery of safe and effective therapeutics for some of the world’s most urgent health needs, submit your application – we’d love to hear from you!

**R\&D MANAGER \- ARIETE**
==========================


**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------


The R\&D Manager will oversee the research and development process for creating new products or improving existing ones in the small home appliances sector, ensuring products meet quality, cost, and timeline objectives.


Main Responsabilities:
  

* Research: Collaborate with Marketing and Design teams to identify consumer needs, trends, and competitor offerings. Stay updated on advancements in technology and materials relevant to small home appliances.
* Idea Generation: Lead brainstorming sessions and work with cross\-functional teams to generate innovative ideas for new products or product enhancements.
* Product Development: Manage the entire product development cycle from conception to commercialization. Coordinate with engineers, designers, and suppliers to ensure products meet quality, cost, and timeline objectives.
* Prototyping and Testing: Oversee the prototyping and testing of new product concepts to validate functionality, performance, and user experience. Iterate designs based on feedback and test results.
* Regulatory Compliance: Work with the Standards \& Approval team to ensure products comply with industry regulations and standards related to safety, performance, and environmental impact.
* Collaboration: Work closely with Marketing, Purchasing, Sales, and Production teams to align product development efforts with market demand and production capabilities.
* Budgeting and Resource Allocation: Manage R\&D budgets and allocate resources effectively to execute projects and maximize return on investment.
* Intellectual Property Management: Identify opportunities to patent new inventions or design elements to protect intellectual property and maintain a competitive market advantage.
* Continuous Improvement: Implement continuous improvement processes in product design, development methodologies, and innovation practices.
* Stakeholder Communication: Communicate progress, challenges, and opportunities to senior management and other stakeholders, providing regular updates on R\&D initiatives and project goals.
* Coordination and management of suppliers in China.

**Job Profile**
---------------


The ideal candidate should have the following experience and characteristics:
  

* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Mechanical Engineering
* Fluent in English (mandatory)
* Experience in designing mechanical components and systems
* Previous experience in dealing with suppliers in China
* Proficiency with 3D design tools (preferably Siemens NX)
* In\-depth knowledge of plastic materials
* Understanding of mechanical processing technologies, plastic deformation, injection molding of plastics, and die casting
* Familiarity with rapid prototyping technologies
* Knowledge of mass production product development
* Experience with laboratory equipment and test result evaluation
* Preferable knowledge of simulation tools (MOLDFLOW, FEM Analysis)
* Personal approach: creative and innovative problem solver; flexible and adaptable with excellent time management skills; team player; self\-motivated;
* Willing to travel
* Strong awareness and demonstrated accountability on cyber security and information protection principles

Benefits:
  

* Wellbeing initiatives (engagement survey, welfare program, health insurance)
* Work\-life balance (flexible work hours, smart working);
* Learning \& Development opportunities (hard and soft skills training, performance appraisal, internal job posting, international career paths)
* Partnerships and shopping programs (special price for company products, external partnerships \& discounts, smart lockers,...)
* Meal tickets

What we offer:
  

* Transparent Compensation: We offer a salary aligned with your expertise and dedication, fostering equity.

Our salary range for this position is 50\.000€\-65\.000€, plus MBO, and the applicable collective bargaining agreement (CCNL) is metalmeccanico.
  

The final offer and classification level may vary based on objective and gender\-neutral criteria, such as the candidate's skills, seniority, background and the qualifications for the job.

**MECHANICAL ENGINEER \- ARIETE**
=================================


**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------


We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Mechanical Engineer.
  

This is a role for a technical expert who thrives in a dynamic environment and is focused on the practical application of engineering and design.
  

The successful candidate will be responsible for the mechanical integrity of our products, contributing directly to CAD design, project execution, and technical product adaptations.


This position is located at the Ariete brand headquarters in Campi Bisenzio (FI).
  

Ariete is a multi\-specialist brand with products present in all categories of small household appliances and with a strong personality, and is a dynamic brand in continuous growth both in Italy and worldwide. Innovation and design are the distinctive elements of Ariete products. Innovation means looking ahead and satisfying every new need dictated by the constant change in consumer trends.
  

Ariete was founded in Florence in 1964, and is part of the De’Longhi Group since 2001\.


Main Responsibilities:
  

* Product Development: Actively participate in the entire product development cycle, from initial concept to mass production. You will be responsible for "hands\-on" 3D CAD modeling and drafting of complex mechanical solutions.
* Technical Design \& Adjustments: Design and engineer mechanical components and systems, with a specific focus on product adaptations and engineering changes to meet evolving technical requirements, quality standards, and cost targets.
* Project Management: Manage individual R\&D projects, defining timelines and ensuring that project milestones are met effectively.
* Prototyping \& Validation: Execute the prototyping phase (including rapid prototyping) and testing of new concepts and design iterations based on lab results and performance feedback to ensure product excellence.
* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Marketing, Purchasing, Quality and Compliance departments to align mechanical design and product adaptations with market needs and manufacturing capabilities.
* Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all mechanical designs and technical modifications comply with international safety regulations and industry standards.

**Job Profile**
---------------


Requirements \& Experience:
  

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering
* CAD Expertise: Advanced proficiency in 3D CAD tools (preferably Siemens NX or similar high\-end software) is mandatory. We are looking for a true power user.
* Plastics Specialist: Extensive experience in the design of plastic components and a deep understanding of plastic injection molding processes and materials
* Mechanical Knowledge: Solid understanding of mechanical processing technologies, plastic deformation, die casting, and assembly methods
* Project Management Skills: Proven ability to manage technical projects, meeting deadlines and specifications autonomously.
* International Mindset: Previous experience working within international teams (specifically with Chinese counterparts/subsidiaries) is highly valued
* Rapid Prototyping: Familiarity with modern rapid prototyping technologies and their application in R\&D
* Languages: Fluency in English is mandatory (written and spoken)
* Soft Skills: Creative problem\-solver with a "can\-do" attitude; flexible, adaptable, and capable of managing time effectively under pressure
* Mobility: Willingness to travel abroad for project\-related needs
* Good/Basic knowledge of the main cyber security and information protection principles

Benefits:
  

* Wellbeing Initiatives: Engagement surveys, comprehensive welfare program, and health insurance
* Work\-Life Balance: Flexible working hours and smart working options
* Learning \& Development: Opportunities for both hard and soft skills training, performance appraisals, and international career paths
* Corporate Perks: Special pricing for company products, external partnerships, discounts, and smart lockers
* Meal tickets

What we offer:
  

* Transparent Compensation: We offer a salary aligned with your expertise and dedication, fostering equity.

Our salary range for this position is 30\.000€\-45\.000€, and the applicable collective bargaining agreement (CCNL) is metalmeccanico.
  

The final offer and classification level may vary based on objective and gender\-neutral criteria, such as the candidate's skills, seniority, background and the qualifications for the job.

title: PRODUCT MANAGER
description:
l nostro cliente è una realtà leader mondiale nella progettazione, produzione e vendita di **prodotti e servizi dedicati al mondo del bowling e dell’intrattenimento**.
  

  

L'azienda si contraddistingue sul mercato per essere un gruppo solido e fortemente orientato all'innovazione, che si distingue sul mercato per l'eccellenza qualitativa e l'affidabilità dei propri prodotti.
  

  

Per loro siamo alla ricerca di una figura di **Product Manager**.
  

  

Il product manager contribuisce a dare forma e far evolvere i prodotti lavorando a stretto contatto con Product Manager e Marketing Manager più esperti.
  

La figura supporterà l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto (dall'ideazione al post\-lancio), bilanciando visione strategica, esigenze di business ed esecuzione operativa. Guiderà i team interfunzionali, allineando gli stakeholder e definendo la direzione.
  

  

Responsabilità Chiave:  

  



* **Gestione della Roadmap e Strategia:** Definire ed evolvere la roadmap del prodotto in allineamento con i business plan e le strategie di *go\-to\-market*, assumendo progressivamente la responsabilità del successo del prodotto sotto la guida di mentori senior.
* **Decisioni Guidate dai Dati:** Analizzare sistematicamente i feedback di clienti e utenti finali, monitorare i dati di utilizzo ed effettuare analisi di mercato per orientare le scelte strategiche sulla roadmap.
* **Coordinamento Interfunzionale:** Guidare i team di sviluppo articolando una visione di prodotto chiara; collaborare stabilmente con i vari stakeholder dall'ideazione dei prototipi fino al lancio finale.
* **Sviluppo Agile e Allineamento:** Promuovere il miglioramento continuo del prodotto attraverso metodologie agili e comunicare regolarmente piani e progressi al team di leadership.
* **Fase di Lancio e Post\-Lancio:** Supportare la prontezza al mercato (*launch readiness*) in sinergia con Marketing e Customer Service, monitorando le performance post\-rilascio e adattando la pianificazione in base ai risultati.
  

  

**Requisiti richiesti:**  

  



* **Laurea** in ambito tecnico, marketing o business (o esperienza equivalente).
* **Doti di leadership e comunicazione**, sia orale che scritta. Capacità di comunicare la propria visione a dirigenti, colleghi e membri del team in modo chiaro e coinvolgente.
* **Fluente conoscenza della lingua inglese.** Siamo un'azienda globale con forza lavoro e clienti in tutto il mondo.
* **Disponibilità a viaggiare** sia a livello nazionale che internazionale.
  

  

**Qualifiche aggiuntive preferenziali:**  

  



* Precedente esperienza in ruoli di Product Management all'interno di team multifunzionali, idealmente nel settore software.
* Background tecnico con conoscenza dello sviluppo software e delle tecnologie web/mobile.
* Esperienza nella definizione dei requisiti di prodotto.
  

  

**Cosa offriamo:**  

  



* Un team veramente globale, con una missione positiva e prodotti utilizzati da milioni di persone ogni giorno.
* Impegno nel supportare la tua crescita professionale con programmi qualificati.
* Modalità di lavoro flessibili e ibride.
  

  

Sede di lavoro: **Bologna**.

-----------

Bitways S.r.l. è un Managed Services Provider IT con sede a Faenza, specializzato in cyber security. Siamo un’azienda in crescita, e vogliamo continuare a farlo senza perdere la nostra identità.

Cerchiamo una figura che possa contribuire a questo percorso di crescita, interfacciandosi direttamente con la direzione con l’obiettivo di operare in completa autonomia. Non cerchiamo chi esegue: cerchiamo chi vuole entrare a far parte di un progetto e dare un contributo alla crescita.

**Cosa offriamo**

▸ Autonomia reale nella gestione del marketing.

▸ Contesto strutturato, team motivato, azienda in crescita.

title: HSE - Internship
description:
**Company Description**  

With its five product lines of compact hydraulics Bosch Rexroth Oil Control SpA, with factories in the province of Modena and Reggio Emilia and over 1,300 employees, has been producing and marketing compact hydraulic components for multiple applications for over 40 years, from aerial platforms to cranes, earth\-moving machinery, agricultural machinery, industrial applications.


What characterizes Bosch Rexroth Oil Control S.p.A. is the ability to study customized solutions in relation to each specific customer requirement. For this reason, the products of Bosch Rexroth Oil Control S.p.A. they are synonymous with quality and represent a guarantee for the global market.


In industrial hydraulics, Bosch Rexroth is actively shaping the transition from conventional to intelligent and connected hydraulics. This opens up enormous potential for the easy and economical integration of machines and systems into modern industrial environments.


Our R\&D department based in Nonantola (MO) is a center of global competence for Compact Hydraulic products

 **Job Description**  

We are looking for an intern to join the HSE Department. The selected candidate will support the team in managing activities related to health, workplace safety, and environmental protection, contributing to the maintenance of company standards and compliance with current regulations.  

In addition, the candidate will be involved in a project focused on the digitalization of HSE processes, with particular attention to the optimization of behavioral monitoring tools.

**Main Responsibilities**

* Support in drafting and updating HSE documentation.
* Assist in monitoring regulatory compliance related to safety and environmental matters.
* Participate in internal audits and workplace inspections.
* Collect and analyze data related to accidents, near misses, and HSE indicators.
* Collaborate in the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives within the HSE area.

**Assigned Project**

* Responsibility for the preliminary study related to the introduction of “smart” digital BBS (Behavior Based Safety) checklists.
* Analyze current processes and identify digitalization needs.
* Evaluate digital tools and solutions for checklist management.
* Support the definition of a standardized and easily implementable model.
* Collaborate with the involved company functions to gather requirements.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Degree in Engineering disciplines, ideally Environmental Engineering, Electrical / Electronic Engineering, or similar fields.
* Interest in health, safety, and environmental topics.
* Good knowledge of the Microsoft Office package (especially Excel).
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Team\-oriented mindset and good communication skills.
* Good command of the English language.

  

**Additional Information**
